name: Remote Detonation's mine hits a neutral, attackable creature, not only hostile ones
contract: A deployed Blast Mine 50045 casts Remote Bomb Explosion 802336 (an enemy area) itself. The mine is a Creature
carrying its owner's faction; without UNIT_FLAG_PLAYER_CONTROLLED, Unit::_IsValidAttackTarget treats it as a creature
and lets it hit only units hostile to it, so a neutral creature the Tinker may attack was never hit. Expected: a
neutral (faction 7) golem 1 yd from the mine takes damage when the Tinker detonates it, as a hostile one does.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
Remote Detonation is not known before any mine exists
Deploy the mine 1 yd from the golem
The live mine grants the Tinker Bomb Ready
Remote Detonation is auto-granted while a mine is live
Remote Detonation triggers the live mine
Remote Detonation actually damages the golem next to the mine
Bomb Ready is lost once its mine is gone
